<!-- This code has been fully generated by an AI. -->

Publishes JavaScript and TypeScript packages to the npm registry (or any compatible registry) after semrel has updated `package.json`. Automatically detects `pnpm`, Yarn Berry, Yarn Classic, or `npm` from your lockfiles.

## Installation

### Binary

```bash
semrel plugin install @semrel/publisher-npm
```

`semrel plugin install` downloads the binary to `.semrel/plugins/` and updates `.semrel.lock`. Commit `.semrel.lock` to pin the version for your team.

### Docker

Pre-built, signed multi-platform images (`linux/amd64`, `linux/arm64`) are published on every release:

```bash
docker pull ghcr.io/semrels/publisher-npm:latest
```

Verify the image signature with cosign:

```bash
cosign verify ghcr.io/semrels/publisher-npm:latest \
  --certificate-identity-regexp 'https://github.com/SemRels/publisher-npm/.github/workflows/release.yml.*' \
  --certificate-oidc-issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com
```

## Configuration

```yaml
version: 1
plugins:
  - uses: @semrel/updater-npm
    phase: pre-tag
    args:
      update_lockfile: "true"

  - uses: @semrel/publisher-npm
    phase: release
    args:
      npm_token: '${env.NPM_TOKEN}'
      npm_tag: latest
      npm_provenance: "true"
      npm_access: public
```

## Environment Variables

| Name | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `SEMREL_PLUGIN_NPM_TOKEN` | yes (unless dry-run) | `—` | npm auth token passed to the package manager as `NODE_AUTH_TOKEN`. |
| `SEMREL_PLUGIN_NPM_TAG` | no | `latest` | Dist-tag passed as `--tag <value>`. |
| `SEMREL_PLUGIN_NPM_PROVENANCE` | no | `false` | When `true`, appends `--provenance` to generate npm provenance attestations. |
| `SEMREL_PLUGIN_NPM_ACCESS` | no | `—` | When set to `public` or `restricted`, appends `--access <value>` (useful for scoped packages). |

## Release Context Variables

- `SEMREL_VERSION`
- `SEMREL_NEXT_VERSION`
- `SEMREL_DRY_RUN`

## Package Manager Detection

`publisher-npm` inspects the working directory in this order:

1. `pnpm-lock.yaml` → `pnpm publish`
2. `yarn.lock` + `.yarnrc.yml` (or `yarn --version >= 2`) → `yarn npm publish`
3. `yarn.lock` → `yarn publish`
4. Default → `npm publish`

When `SEMREL_DRY_RUN=true`, the plugin logs the resolved package name, version, and exact publish command without invoking the registry upload.
